name: glaciora
description: GLACIORA — boutique en ligne ski, hockey et sports de neige

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @glaciora/shared && npm run db:generate
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @glaciora/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @glaciora/api" "npm run dev -w @glaciora/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @glaciora/shared && npm run build -w @glaciora/api && npm run build -w @glaciora/web
scripts.start: npm run db:deploy && npm run start -w @glaciora/api
